name: Steady (formerly Status Hero)
description_en:
Steady is a coordination service that combines people’s check-ins, goal updates and activity from connected work tools. Daily summaries, recurring Echoes and integrations help readers follow progress across teams. Status Hero’s original domain redirects here, and the official January 2024 announcement confirms the name change.

It is useful to evaluate as a layer over existing work systems: a merged pull request supplies activity, while a person explains the outcome, next step and blocker. Current pricing is based on deliveries and model tokens rather than new-account seat fees. Visibility defaults, recipient counts and cancellation conditions materially affect that workflow.
description_zh:
Steady 是协调服务，组合人员签到、目标更新及已连接工作工具的活动。每日摘要、重复 Echoes 及集成帮助读者了解跨团队进展。Status Hero 原域名跳转至此，官方2024年1月公告确认了更名。

可把它作为现有工作系统之上的协调层评估：已合并 PR 提供活动，人员再解释结果、下一步及阻碍。当前价格按投递及模型 token 计费，新账户不按席位收费。默认可见范围、接收人数及取消条件会实质影响此流程。

core_features.explanation_en: Quick Fill drafts an update from activity; the author can edit before posting.
core_features.explanation_zh: Quick Fill 从活动生成更新草稿，作者可在发布前编辑。

core_features.explanation_en: Goal owners receive cadence reminders; contributors can also update.
core_features.explanation_zh: 目标所有者按周期接收提醒，贡献者也可更新。

core_features.explanation_en: Scheduled answers use each recipient’s accessible context.
core_features.explanation_zh: 定时回答使用每位接收者有权访问的上下文。

en: Coordinate an engineering release using check-ins for blockers and a Goal Story for outcome updates.
zh: 用签到汇报阻碍，用 Goal Story 更新结果，以协调工程发布。
use_cases.basis: Hypothetical evaluation, not a customer outcome.

Delivery model.en: Hosted workspace; chat/email/Digest distribution and webhook/MCP interfaces require separate account and permissions setup. No self-hosted distribution established.
Delivery model.zh: 托管工作区；聊天／邮件／Digest 投递及 webhook／MCP 接口需另行设置账户及权限。未确立自行托管发行版。

steps.en: Confirm credit plan and team visibility before connecting work tools or inviting members.
steps.zh: 连接工作工具或邀请成员前，确认积分方案及团队可见范围。

steps.en: Pilot one activity source, edited check-in and goal update; compare recipient access and measured usage.
steps.zh: 试点一个活动来源、一条编辑后的签到及目标更新；比较接收者访问与实际用量。

integrations.scope: GitHub webhook ingestion and account-scoped MCP read/write documented. No external authorization or delivery tested.

items.en: Open teams expose updates to other workspace users by default; public involved teams override a goal’s restricted setting.
items.zh: 团队默认开放更新给工作区其他用户；关联开放团队会覆盖目标的受限设置。

items.en: Echoes share presets, not identical answers, and do not directly autopost to Slack/Teams channels.
items.zh: Echoes 分享预设而非相同回答，不直接自动发至 Slack／Teams 频道。

license.scope: Hosted-service terms reserve vendor IP. A separately open coordination methodology is not an application source license.

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Displayed entry pack:500credits for$25/month; larger packs/topups available. Delivery audience and LLM tokens consume credits; no seat charge for current plan. Currency code/tax/checkout unverified; initial credits are not sustained free usage.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 展示起始包为每月 $25／500积分，可选更大包及充值。接收人数与 LLM token 消耗积分；当前方案不收席位费。币种代码／税／结账未核实；初始积分不表示持续免费。

review_notes: English and Chinese were checked against the sources attached to each section. Editorial examples and selection judgments are not customer evidence.
Read_at is retrieval time; public-reader text may be cached and does not establish vendor update time.
Draft documentation research only. Independent review, hands-on testing, owner verification and publishing approval remain separate.

sections.title_en: A pull request is evidence to explain, not a complete update
sections.title_zh: PR 是待解释证据，不是完整更新
sections.en:
For a proposed release review, use a merged PR as supporting activity, then explain what is ready, what remains and who can unblock it. Smart Check-ins combine imported activity with human plans, progress and blockers; Quick Fill is an editable draft. A commit does not establish that a user-facing outcome passed acceptance.

Steady adds the coordination narrative above an issue tracker or source repository. Keep acceptance criteria and delivery evidence in the system that owns them. Inspect the drafted text before posting, especially if the source activity is incomplete or belongs to a different time period.
sections.zh:
假设复核一次发布，可用已合并 PR 支撑活动，再解释什么已就绪、剩余什么及谁能解除阻碍。Smart Check-ins 组合导入活动与人员的计划、进展及阻碍；Quick Fill 是可编辑草稿。提交不证明用户可见结果通过验收。

Steady 在工单或源码仓库之上补充协调叙述。验收条件及交付证据应保留在其权威系统。发布前检查草稿，尤其是来源活动不全或属于其他时段时。

sections.title_en: Assign an outcome owner and a useful update cadence
sections.title_zh: 指定结果负责人及有用更新周期
sections.en:
Goal Stories identify an owner, contributors and involved teams. Only the owner receives update reminders, although contributors can edit and post. Start dates anchor the reminder cycle; reminders stop at the goal’s end date. A confidence assessment and a progress percentage express different judgments.

For a release outcome, choose an owner able to explain risk and make a useful decision request. Do not create a separate goal for every small ticket merely to reproduce the issue backlog. After a due date passes, inspect whether reporting still needs attention rather than assuming reminders continue.
sections.zh:
Goal Stories 标识所有者、贡献者及参与团队。只有所有者接收更新提醒，贡献者也可编辑和发布。开始日决定提醒节奏，结束日后停止提醒。信心评估与进度百分比表达不同判断。

针对发布结果，应选择能解释风险、提出有用决策请求的负责人。不要为每张小工单新建目标，只为重现待办列表。到期后应检查是否仍需汇报，不要假设提醒持续。

sections.title_en: Set visibility before increasing the audience
sections.title_zh: 扩大接收范围前设置可见性
sections.en:
New teams default to open, allowing other workspace users to view updates. Private teams restrict visibility to members. A Goal Story attached to an open team remains visible workspace-wide even if its own setting selects involved teams. These are workspace boundaries, not proof of anonymous public access.

Map who needs each update before inviting observers. Test with an ordinary participant, an outside-team colleague and an administrator using harmless content. Broad access also changes delivery volume; permission review and cost estimation should use the same intended audience.
sections.zh:
新团队默认开放，工作区其他用户可查看更新；私有团队限成员查看。Goal Story 若关联开放团队，即使自身选择参与团队可见，仍会在工作区范围可见。这些是工作区边界，不证明匿名公网访问。

邀请观察者前，应明确每条更新由谁阅读。用无害内容分别检查普通参与者、团队外同事及管理员视角。更广访问也改变投递量，权限复核与费用估算应采用相同目标接收范围。

sections.title_en: Sharing an Echo preset preserves personalized answers
sections.title_zh: 分享 Echo 预设仍保留个人化回答
sections.en:
Echoes answer a recurring question on a chosen schedule using check-ins, goals and activity. A preview lets the author refine the question. Sharing distributes the preset: each person saves it and receives an answer scoped to their own access. It does not distribute one person’s identical answer.

The help page explicitly says Echoes do not automatically post answers to Slack or Teams channels. External retrieval through API, CLI or MCP is a separate path with its own disclosure risk. For a stakeholder digest, compare the intended readers’ access before choosing a broad channel or copying an answer elsewhere.
sections.zh:
Echoes 按所选周期利用签到、目标及活动回答重复问题；预览可帮助作者调整问题。分享分发的是预设，每人保存后按自身权限获得回答，不是分发某个人的同一份回答。

帮助页明确称 Echoes 不自动把回答发至 Slack 或 Teams 频道。经 API、CLI 或 MCP 获取属于独立路径，也有自己的披露风险。针对干系人摘要，应先比较目标读者权限，再选择广泛频道或把回答复制到其他位置。

sections.title_en: Check attribution before trusting imported context
sections.title_zh: 信任导入上下文前核对归属
sections.en:
GitHub documentation describes webhook setup and checks for matching author identities, email addresses and commit timestamps. Missing PR activity or an older timestamp can therefore be a configuration/data-mapping issue rather than proof no work happened. Inspect the Activity view before judging a missing check-in reference.

MCP supports reading context and creating updates under each connected person’s existing permissions. That access is broader than reading a summary. The AI policy says subprocessors perform inference without model training; this is a vendor policy, not an independent audit. No webhook, assistant or external account was connected in this review.
sections.zh:
GitHub 文档描述 webhook 设置，并要求核对作者身份、邮箱及提交时间戳。因此 PR 活动缺失或时间较早可能来自配置／映射问题，不能证明没有工作。判断签到引用缺失前，应先检查 Activity。

MCP 可按每位连接者原有权限读取上下文及创建更新，访问范围超出只读摘要。AI 政策称分处理方执行推理且不训练模型；这是厂商政策，不是独立审计。本次没有连接 webhook、助手或外部账户。

sections.title_en: Estimate recipients and token use, not seats alone
sections.title_zh: 估算接收者与 token 用量，不能只数席位
sections.en:
A delivery is counted per recipient. As a hypothetical minimum, eight check-ins each reaching seven colleagues on twenty workdays create 8 × 7 × 20 = 1,120 check-in delivery credits. Team summaries, goal updates, Echoes and model tokens add usage. Compare this with measured workspace categories instead of treating the page’s uninitialized zero calculator as a quote.

The current public pack starts at $25/month for 500 credits. Running out stops deliveries while activity collection continues for seven days; no automatic overage charge is stated. Credit carryover wording differs between an active account and an active plan, so confirm the intended subscription state. Older accounts may retain seat billing; do not apply this new-account model universally.
sections.zh:
每位接收者分别计算一次投递。假设八人每天签到，各送达七位同事，每月二十个工作日，仅签到即消耗 8 × 7 × 20 = 1,120 积分。团队摘要、目标更新、Echoes 及模型 token 另增加用量。应与工作区分类实际消耗比较，不能把页面未初始化的零值计算器当报价。

当前公开包从每月 $25／500积分开始。用尽后停止投递，活动继续收集七天；文档称无自动超额收费。积分保留条件分别写活跃账户与活跃方案，应确认目标订阅状态。旧账户可能保留席位计费，不能一概套用新账户模型。

sections.title_en: Cancellation ends access before the documented deletion date
sections.title_zh: 取消会在文档所称删除日前结束访问
sections.en:
Terms say cancellation takes effect immediately: service data becomes inaccessible and unused credits are forfeited without prorating. The cancellation help page separately says server data is completely deleted sixty days after cancellation. A retention period is not a promised user recovery window.

Before closing a workspace, obtain the records needed elsewhere, confirm their completeness and resolve any remaining credit/refund questions. A current comprehensive export/import path was not established here. The ability to use a hosted coordination method does not grant a license to copy Steady’s application source or content.
sections.zh:
条款称取消立即生效：服务数据不可访问，未用积分作废且不按比例退款。取消帮助页另称取消六十天后服务器数据完全删除。保留期不等于承诺用户可自行恢复的窗口。

关闭工作区前，应取得需在其他位置保留的记录、确认完整性，并解决剩余积分／退款问题。本次未确立当前完整导出／导入路径。能够使用托管协调方法，也不表示获准复制 Steady 应用源码或内容。

seo.title_en: Steady, Formerly Status Hero: Check-ins, Credits and Access
seo.title_zh: Steady（原 Status Hero）：签到、积分与访问范围
seo.description_en: Evaluate Steady goal updates, personalized Echoes, credit consumption, open-team visibility and cancellation conditions.
seo.description_zh: 评估 Steady 目标更新、个人化 Echoes、积分消耗、开放团队可见性及取消条件。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate coordination workflows and recipient-based usage.
secondary_questions: Does sharing an Echo share its answer?
seo.query_basis: Editorial hypotheses; no measured demand or ranking.

research_gaps.en: No signup, invitation, integration, check-in, goal change, AI generation, MCP call, delivery, payment, cancellation or data restoration tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试注册、邀请、集成、签到、目标修改、AI 生成、MCP 调用、投递、付款、取消或数据恢复。

research_gaps.en: Exact currency/checkout/tax, top-up rates, active-plan versus active-account carryover, legacy billing, complete export/import, full interface languages and third-party client compatibility remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 准确币种／结账／税、充值费率、活跃方案与活跃账户的积分保留差异、旧计费、完整导出／导入、全部界面语言及第三方客户端兼容性未核实。
